enriched_activities.desc: Lies in bed. Closes eyes. Pulls blanket over body. Places head on pillow. Remains asleep. Turns from back to left side. Adjusts pillow. Pulls blanket. Remains asleep. Turns from left side to back. Moves right arm under pillow. Remains asleep. Turns to right side. Pulls blanket. Remains asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Opens eyes. Sits up on bed. Swings legs to floor. Stands up. Walks to bathroom. Turns on bathroom light. Turns on tap. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Turns off tap. Picks up towel. Wipes face. Hangs towel. Turns off bathroom light. Walks out of bathroom.

Walks into kitchen. Turns on kitchen light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out milk, eggs, and bread. Closes refrigerator. Places items on counter. Opens cabinet. Takes out bowl and plate. Closes cabinet. Cracks eggs into bowl. Stirs eggs with chopsticks. Turns on induction cooker. Places pan on cooker. Pours oil into pan. Pours egg mixture into pan. Stirs eggs. Turns off induction cooker. Places eggs on plate. Places bread in toaster. Presses toaster lever. Removes toast. Pours milk into glass. Sits at table. Picks up fork. Eats eggs and toast. Drinks milk. Stands up. Carries dishes to sink. Rinses dishes. Places dishes in dishwasher. Turns off kitchen light. Walks out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing work items for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into Bedroom 1. Opens wardrobe. Takes out work clothes. Closes wardrobe. Takes off sleepwear. Puts on work clothes. Opens drawer. Takes out socks. Puts on socks. Takes out shoes. Puts on shoes. Walks to mirror. Picks up comb. Combs hair. Puts down comb. Opens desk drawer. Takes out ID badge. Puts ID badge in pocket. Picks up stethoscope. Puts stethoscope in work bag. Picks up phone. Unplugs phone charger. Puts phone in pocket. Picks up work bag. Picks up keys. Turns off bedroom light. Walks out of Bedroom 1.

Walks out of home. Closes door. Locks door. Walks to bus stop. Stands at bus stop. Boards bus. Taps transit card. Walks to seat. Sits down. Holds handrail. Takes phone out of pocket. Looks at phone screen. Puts phone in pocket. Stands up. Walks to bus door. Steps off bus. Walks to hospital entrance. Opens hospital door. Walks into hospital. Walks to locker room. Opens locker. Changes shoes. Closes locker. Walks to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, attending to patients and clinical duties
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into ward. Washes hands. Puts on gloves. Picks up patient chart. Walks to patient bed. Says 'Good morning' to patient. Checks patient ID wristband. Picks up blood pressure cuff. Wraps cuff around patient arm. Presses start button. Reads monitor. Removes cuff. Picks up thermometer. Places thermometer under patient tongue. Removes thermometer. Reads temperature. Records data on computer. Picks up stethoscope. Places stethoscope on patient chest. Listens. Removes stethoscope. Adjusts IV drip rate. Checks IV bag. Replaces IV bag. Disposes gloves. Washes hands. Picks up medication tray. Walks to next patient. Says 'Good morning' to patient. Checks patient ID wristband. Places medication tray on table. Hands medication cup to patient. Pours water into cup. Hands water cup to patient. Records medication on computer. Picks up chart. Walks to nurses station. Attends briefing. Writes notes. Uses computer. Answers phone. Says 'Hello, hospital ward.' Transfers call. Picks up supplies. Walks to patient room. Restocks supplies. Checks monitor. Adjusts bed rail. Lowers bed rail. Raises bed rail. Checks call button. Places call button near patient hand. Walks to next bed. Checks vital signs. Records data. Washes hands. Removes gloves. Walks to break area. Sits. Eats lunch. Drinks water. Stands. Washes hands. Returns to ward. Picks up chart. Walks to patient bed. Checks IV site. Changes dressing. Disposes old dressing. Washes hands. Puts on new gloves. Applies new dressing. Removes gloves. Washes hands. Records data. Walks to computer. Types notes. Logs out. Picks up phone. Checks messages. Puts phone in pocket. Picks up bag. Walks to locker room. Opens locker. Changes shoes. Closes locker. Walks to exit. Opens door. Walks out of hospital.

Walks out of hospital. Walks to bus stop. Stands at bus stop. Boards bus. Taps transit card. Walks to seat. Sits down. Takes phone out of pocket. Looks at phone screen. Puts phone in pocket. Stands up. Walks to bus door. Steps off bus. Walks to home. Opens home door. Walks into home. Closes door. Locks door. Takes off shoes. Places shoes on rack. Hangs coat. Puts work bag on floor. Walks into kitchen.

Walks into kitchen. Turns on kitchen light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out vegetables, meat, and water bottle. Closes refrigerator. Places items on counter. Opens cabinet. Takes out cutting board and knife. Closes cabinet. Washes vegetables. Places vegetables on cutting board. Cuts vegetables. Cuts meat. Turns on induction cooker. Places pan on cooker. Pours oil into pan. Adds meat to pan. Stirs meat. Adds vegetables to pan. Stirs vegetables. Adds salt. Turns off induction cooker. Places food on plate. Carries plate to table. Sits at table. Picks up fork. Eats dinner. Drinks water. Stands up. Carries plate to sink. Rinses plate. Places plate in dishwasher. Turns off kitchen light. Walks out of kitchen.

Walks into bathroom. Turns on bathroom light. Takes off clothes. Places clothes in hamper. Turns on shower tap. Adjusts water temperature. Steps into shower. Wets body. Picks up soap. Rubs soap on body. Rinses body. Picks up shampoo. Applies shampoo to hair. Rinses hair. Turns off shower tap. Steps out of shower. Picks up towel. Dries body. Dries hair. Hangs towel. Puts on pajamas. Turns off bathroom light. Walks out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing, watching TV and using computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into living room. Sits on sofa. Picks up remote. Presses power button. Turns on TV. Selects channel. Puts remote on table. Picks up laptop. Opens laptop. Presses power button. Turns on computer. Types on keyboard. Uses mouse. Opens browser. Watches video. Picks up phone. Checks messages. Puts phone on table. Stands up. Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out water bottle. Closes refrigerator. Walks to living room. Sits on sofa. Drinks water. Puts water bottle on table. Picks up remote. Presses power button. Turns off TV. Closes laptop. Stands up. Walks to Bedroom 1.

enriched_activities.activity: Bedtime routine, winding down and preparing for sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into Bedroom 1. Turns on desk lamp. Takes off clothes. Puts on pajamas. Picks up phone. Plugs phone charger into wall. Connects phone to charger. Places phone on nightstand. Pulls back blanket. Fluffs pillow. Lies on bed. Pulls blanket over body. Picks up phone. Sets alarm. Places phone on nightstand. Turns off desk lamp. Closes eyes.

Lies in bed. Closes eyes. Pulls blanket over body. Places head on pillow. Remains asleep. Turns to left side. Adjusts pillow. Pulls blanket. Remains asleep. Turns to back. Moves arm under pillow. Remains asleep. Turns to right side. Pulls blanket. Remains asleep.
